mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_lifecycle_operation WHERE operation_no = #{operationNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM account_lifecycle_operation WHERE operation_type = 'ACCOUNT_CANCEL' AND status IN ('FENCED', 'VALIDATING', 'EXECUTING', 'RETRY_PENDING') AND (next_wakeup_at IS NULL OR next_wakeup_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_wakeup_at, created_at), id LIMIT #{limit}
